description: Oregon fabric HRU id crosswalk for the model_layers_9 fabric: the national nhm_id (sparse, 1-41195) that every pre-#353 Oregon artifact was keyed on, paired with hru_id (dense, 1-16814) which the project now uses. Both columns come from the same row of the same fabric file, so the mapping cannot disagree with the geometry.
note: Applies to model_layers_9, the fabric used by this project and by the gfv2-params workflows. Use it to map data joined to the old nhm_id onto the hru_id-keyed targets.
